contract: acquisition(mu, sigma, f_best) -> one score per candidate point (higher = evaluate next) for a Gaussian-process BO loop on a synthetic function (FunBO contract). Score: mean simple regret after the evaluation budget
protocol_description: Reimplemented in this repository from the paper's task description; instances are generated locally with a fixed seed, so scores are comparable within the suite but not with the paper's numbers.
name: OOD Hartmann 6D
description: OOD Hartmann 6D: optimize the candidate specified by the paper and evaluate against the named benchmark.
paper_metric: simple regret and trials to optimum

sources.locator: Paper-cited comparison repository; objective functions bra,gprice,hm3 (not original FunBO source)

limitations: No dedicated official FunBO evaluator repository was verified. The nine OOD adapters are explicitly attributed paper-guided reconstructions using the paper-cited MetaBO objective source.
Exact original Sobol points and some standard-objective internal parameters are unavailable; assumptions and fingerprints are documented per task.
No full FunSearch discovery or complete paper experiment has been reproduced.
Execution interface inspected in pinned source. Full paper experiments have not been reproduced here.

papers.title: FunBO: Discovering Acquisition Functions for Bayesian Optimization with FunSearch
